create_ListDataset: create a ListDataset wrapping a list of items as a PyTorch Dataset
use_ListDataset_getitem: use ListDataset __getitem__ to retrieve an item by index
use_ListDataset_len: use ListDataset __len__ to get the number of items in the dataset

run_PIL_to_bytes_png: run PIL_to_bytes with png format to convert a PIL image to PNG bytes
